About

PAY//AGENT is a design concept with a simulation. It is published to invite review of one idea: agent payments need rules that the agent cannot argue with.

Scope

In scope: the client-side policy layer, its configuration format, receipts, error codes and threat model.

Out of scope: the x402 protocol itself, facilitators, settlement, wallets, custody, and any payment processing. PAY//AGENT is not the official x402 protocol and is not affiliated with the x402 project, Coinbase or any company named on this site. It has no partners, customers or integrations.
